name: mucyora-auth-app
description: Secure, accessible authentication frontend and same-origin Auth gateway for MUCYORA

scripts.check: npm run check:structure && npm run check:no-gradients && npm run check:contrast && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts tests/e2e/keyboard.spec.ts tests/e2e/responsive.spec.ts tests/e2e/auth-flows.spec.ts tests/e2e/no-network.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:e2e:all: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts tests/e2e/keyboard.spec.ts tests/e2e/responsive.spec.ts tests/e2e/auth-flows.spec.ts tests/e2e/no-network.spec.ts
scripts.test:a11y: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:visual: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/visual.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:visual:update: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/visual.spec.ts --project=chromium --update-snapshots
scripts.test:no-network: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/no-network.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
